name: The Den
summary: Braelyn Firehand sends Horde champions into the Talon Den's hidden barrow chambers to seize the druids' relics. This infiltration campaign reaches its climax as they face layered defenses beneath Stonetalon Peak.

sections.title: Subterranean Secrets
sections.body: High on the Stonetalon Mountains, the Talon Den shelters night elf druids in halls carved deep into living stone. The barrow chambers protect meditating guardians and keep sacred treasures from prying eyes. Knowing the value of what lies within, Braelyn Firehand questions a captured druid to learn how the defenses work.

sections.title: The Layered Locks
sections.body: The druids protect their relics with a chain of locks. A lantern at the barrow entrance hides the Gatekeeper's Key, which opens three caches deeper inside. Those caches hold the Sleepers' Key, the Claw Key, and the Barrow Key. Turning all three carved stones in the central hoard breaks the druidic seals and leaves the ancient items in Horde hands.

faq.answer: The Talon Den is a night elf barrow complex carved into the heights of Stonetalon Peak. Its halls shelter resting druids and guard their sacred relics.

faq.q: Who orders the infiltration of the Talon Den?
aliases: who sent me to the den
faq.answer: Braelyn Firehand, a Sin'dorei operative working alongside the Horde in the Stonetalon Mountains, directs the infiltration. After questioning a captured druid about the sanctuary's defenses, she sends Horde agents toward its hoard.

faq.q: How do the keys inside the Den work?
aliases: how to open talon den hoard
faq.answer: The primary Gatekeeper's Key lies inside a lantern near the entrance. It opens three caches in the barrow, which hold the Sleepers' Key, the Claw Key, and the Barrow Key. Turning all three carved stones in the hoard dissolves its wards.

faq.q: Why are the druids on Stonetalon Peak being targeted?
faq.answer: Braelyn Firehand wants the area's flow of magic restored and blames the druids of Stonetalon Peak and the sons of Cenarius for blocking it. She has the druids slain, including their leader Keeper Ordanus, whom she says she once knew, then sends you to strip the Den of its powerful items.

faq.q: What is inside the Talon Den Hoard?
faq.answer: The Talon Den Hoard holds powerful relics and treasures gathered by the night elf druids. Its wards kept them safe from foreign intrusion until Braelyn coerced the security sequence.

faq.q: What happened right before this quest?
faq.answer: Before you break into the Den, Horde adventurers are assigned to investigate the night elf presence in Cenarius' Legacy and assassinate Keeper Ordanus, weakening the defenders' command.

angles.text: Raiding the Talon Den weakens the night elves' defenses atop Stonetalon Peak, secures the mountain approaches, and puts potent magical relics in Horde hands.
As a night elf, you see the Talon Den desecrated: the ancient sleep of Cenarion guardians is disturbed, and their ward-locked relics are plundered.
As a tauren druid of the Horde, you face a bitter irony: keys named for Sleepers, Claws, and Barrows turn the barrow defenses against fellow Cenarion keepers.
As a rogue, you rely on keen infiltration and subterfuge to navigate the shadowy halls and lift keys from hidden lanterns and torch brackets.
